summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Pre-Registros tab in admin panel. All 21 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified stats display, table rendering, expand row details, edit functionality with save, search, and filter features.
critical_code_review_comments: PreRegistrationManagement.jsx correctly uses RaceConfigContext for race_code
API endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id and edit_token from responses
BIB uniqueness validation implemented in PUT endpoint (lines 849-859)
Stats endpoint includes talla_distribution for t-shirt size planning
Edit form correctly handles BIB assignment with next-bib button
data-testid attributes present for search and filter elements
